Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: أَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَهَبْ لِيَ الْعَافِيَةَ مِنْ دَيْنٍ تُخْلِقُ بِهِ وَجْهِي
Translation: And grant me well-being from a debt that tarnishes my reputation

Arabic text: وَيَحَارُ فِيْهِ ذِهْنِي، وَيَتَشَعَّبُ لَهُ فِكْرِي
Translation: And confuses my mind, and scatters my thoughts
And extends my preoccupation in managing it

Arabic text: وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ يَا رَبِّ مِنْ هَمِّ الدَّيْنِ وَفِكْرِهِ
Translation: And I seek refuge with You, O Lord, from the anxiety of debt and its worry
And the distraction of debt and its sleeplessness

Arabic text: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ وَأَعِذْنِيْ مِنْهُ
Translation: So send blessings upon Muhammad and his family and protect me from it

Arabic text: وَأَسْتَجِيرُ بِكَ يَا رَبِّ مِنْ ذِلَّتِهِ فِيْ الْحَيَاةِ
Translation: And I seek Your protection, O Lord, from its humiliation in life
And from its consequences after death

Arabic text: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ وَأَجِرْنِيْ مِنْهُ
Translation: So send blessings upon Muhammad and his family and save me from it
With abundant prosperity or sufficient sustenance

Arabic text: أَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family
And protect me from extravagance and excess
And guide me to generosity and moderation
And teach me good planning
And hold me back with Your kindness from wastefulness
And make my sustenance flow from lawful means
And direct my spending toward righteous causes

Arabic text: وَازْوِ عَنِّيْ مِنَ الْمَالِ مَا يُحْدِثُ لِيْ مَخِيلَةً
Translation: And keep away from me wealth that would cause me arrogance

Arabic text: أَوْ تَأَدِّيًا إِلَى بَغْيٍ، أَوْ مَا أَتَعَقَّبُ مِنْهُ طُغْيَانًا
Translation: Or lead to transgression, or result in tyranny
O Allah, make me love the company of the poor
And help me to be in their company with good patience

Arabic text: وَمَا زَوَيْتَ عَنِّيْ مِنْ مَتَاعِ الدُّنْيَا الْفَانِيَةِ
Translation: And whatever You have kept away from me of the passing enjoyments of this world
Store it for me in Your everlasting treasuries
And make what You have granted me of its debris

Arabic text: وَعَجَّلْتَ لِيْ مِنْ مَتَاعِهَا بُلْغَةً إِلَى جِوَارِكَ
Translation: And hastened for me of its pleasures a means to reach Your proximity

Arabic text: وَوُصْلَةً إِلَى قُرْبِكَ، وَذَرِيْعَةً إِلَى جَنَّتِكَ
Translation: And a connection to Your nearness, and a path to Your Paradise
Verily, You are the Possessor of Great Bounty
And You are the Generous, the Noble
